lead_raw_text:
The structure of LiCu₃S₄ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4₂/mnm (No. 143), with a unit cell containing 32 atoms—Li₄Cu₁₂S₁₆—distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu centers in tetrahedral S₄ environments (four atoms per cell) and octahedral S-centered coordination (four atoms per cell), while Li centers adopt an octahedral S₆ environment. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Cu tetrahedra and Li octahedra, edge-sharing between Li octahedra, and corner-sharing between Cu tetrahedra and S octahedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 32 sites.
